title: Trapezoid Profile Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Set a distance, a speed limit and an acceleration limit and watch the speed graph of a joint move change between a trapezoid and a triangle. Then calculate the times and the peak speed for six problems. Used in Chapter 11.

educational.topic: Trapezoidal velocity profile: speed limit, acceleration limit and move time
learningObjectives: Calculate the acceleration time, cruise time, total time and peak speed of a joint move under a trapezoidal velocity profile, for six problems, to within the tolerance shown, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Repeated calculation on new numbers with an immediate check, including a short move that forces the learner to test the condition before choosing a formula
keyQuestions: Does this move reach the speed limit? How do you know?
Which parts of the move take the extra time beyond distance divided by speed?
commonMisconceptions: The move always reaches the speed limit
The time is the distance divided by the speed limit
A higher acceleration limit changes the cruise speed
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed numeric answers, one attempt each, checked against a tolerance; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Speed limit v
controls.range: 10 to 120 degrees per second, step 10, default 60

controls.label: Acceleration limit a
controls.range: 20 to 400 degrees per second squared, step 20, default 120

controls.label: Check / Next problem / See score / Try again
